truth.how_the_frontier_actually_handles_this: Frontier coding agents do not arbitrate their own tools by consensus either: they run the command and read its exit status and diff, which is conformance, and the check that matters is whether the run did what was asked. Multi-reader schemes in the literature are used to surface conflicts for escalation, not to overwrite an outcome that already executed -- exactly the distinction this round measures.
truth.the_law_this_round_adds: A fact is a prediction of the action it gates, not a description of the world. Its correctness is conformance to that action's outcome, and no amount of reader agreement can override the outcome. Two free readers are worth reading because they locate the doubt; they are the wrong thing to ask for the verdict.
